item.title: Was John Lennon gay? Paul McCartney discussed bandmate’s sexuality rumors in unearthed interview
item.description: Shortly after John Lennon’s death, his wife, Yoko Ono, told bandmate Paul McCartney that she suspected her husband might have been gay. McCartney told Vanity Fair in a 2015 interview released in full on Friday, coinciding with the premiere of Man on the Run, a new documentary about his life after The Beatles.
